title: AVELOX (moxifloxacin hydrochloride) tablet, film coated — FDA label (DailyMed)

claims.text: This source is the FDA product label for AVELOX (moxifloxacin hydrochloride), an oral/IV fluoroquinolone antibiotic — not a meningitis-specific reference.
General (non-meningitis) AVELOX dosing for adults is 400 mg orally or IV once every 24 hours.
claims.byte_quote: The dose of AVELOX is 400 mg (orally or as an intravenous infusion) once every 24 hours.
